scientific_limitations: Does not classify nonidempotent derivations or other two-step nilpotent Lie algebras.

scientific_scope: The Heisenberg Lie algebra of dimension 2n+1 over any finite field, n>=2; all linear idempotent derivations, complete rank polynomial and fixed-field conditional asymptotics.
title: Idempotent derivations of finite Heisenberg Lie algebras: symplectic rank strata and a rare characteristic-two phase
